channel.title: Victor Vieux
channel.description: Posts by Victor Vieux about software engineering, AI-assisted development, and personal projects.

item.title: Local Voice Routines with an Old Amazon Echo Dot and Home Assistant
item.description: I repurposed old Echo Dots with EchoLocal and custom wake word models to trigger Home Assistant routines without a voice assistant pipeline.

item.title: Rewriting My Expo App in Native Kotlin
item.description: I rewrote CocktailSnap from Expo and React Native to native Kotlin, then submitted it to Google Play—all in four hours.

item.title: Restoring My 2007 Qt Apps With Codex
item.description: I restored two undocumented Qt applications from 2007 and made them run on an Apple Silicon Mac.

item.title: Building DamN64: LLM-Assisted N64 Development
item.description: How I built an isometric, two-player Nintendo 64 game with LLM-assisted development.
